Beefy is a yield optimizer that automatically compounds rewards from liquidity mining positions. Beefy runs its vaults through smart contracts on public blockchains. Beefy operates across multiple blockchains.

Pickle Jars are yield aggregation vaults on Ethereum. Pickle Jars accept deposits of liquidity provider tokens. Pickle Jars automatically compound farming rewards through smart contracts.

Rari Capital is a decentralized finance protocol built on Ethereum. Rari Capital offers Earn yield pools that allocate deposited funds across lending markets. Rari Capital provides Fuse, a permissionless lending platform.
